Lantern Keepers are an entity in Example Game. They carry a lamp that never goes out and they are not hostile to travellers who stay on the path.

Contents

  • Appearance
  • Trivia

Appearance[edit]

A Lantern Keeper is a tall figure in a grey coat.[1] The lamp gives off a warm light that reaches about ten metres.

A keeper at rest

Location[edit]

Seen in the first three levels.
